reuse.why: getNextDate is extended and reused by the budget template, but getUpcomingDates writes its own daily-skip filter instead of going through a shared occurrence/weekend helper.

duplication.why: The 'daily + skipWeekend means drop weekend occurrences, otherwise move them' rule is encoded three times: getNextDate (skipsWeekendDays/movesWeekend), getUpcomingDates (its own skipsWeekendDays, count*7 over-fetch and filter) and schedule-template (isDaily passed as noSkipWeekend plus its own skipWeekend ternary).

placement.why: The core rule rightly sits in shared/schedules.ts, but server/schedules/app.ts and budget/schedule-template.ts each re-decide it locally.

scope.why: Focused on the rule plus a frequency field on the schedule data; the schedule-template loop is restructured more than needed.

maintainability.why: A future change to how daily weekends are handled must be made consistently in three files using three different mechanisms (scan 7, over-fetch 7x, and inverting the noSkipWeekend flag), with the template relying on the inverted flag to turn the skip on.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates filters weekend dates itself instead of using getNextDate/a shared helper; budget/schedule-template.ts toggles getNextDate's noSkipWeekend by frequency and keeps its own getDateWithSkippedWeekend ternary

disguised_duplication.where: getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts re-expresses getNextDate's skipsWeekendDays rule as an over-fetch-filter-slice pipeline; schedule-template.ts expresses it as !isDaily passed into getNextDate

one_place.where: Daily weekend skip is decided separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList
